interface.longDescription: v0.8 Guardian Cognitive Evolution makes the ten specialist Guardians compound intelligence from verified work. They retain personal skill evidence, calibrate confidence, learn recurring failure signatures, generate counterfactual replay strategies and self-curricula, and consume verified peer lessons without inheriting peer performance scores. Routing evidence remains bounded and cannot grant permissions, mutate hosted model weights live, or silently approve benchmark truth.
capabilities: Learn automatically from verified specialist outcomes
Transfer verified lessons between specialist Guardians without copying scores
Calibrate confidence against observed success and failure
Cluster recurring failures and generate counterfactual replay strategies
Generate personalized self-training curricula from weaknesses and evidence
Route missions using bounded adaptive and cognitive evidence without changing permissions
Replay Benchmark Vault candidates and measure benchmark coverage intelligence
defaultPrompt: Show the cognitive and adaptive intelligence summary for my specialist Guardians.
What has this Guardian learned, and what should it practice next?
Show transferable lessons relevant to this mission without copying another Guardian's score.
Generate counterfactual strategies for this verified failure.
Route this mission using verified cognitive evidence without changing tool permissions.

name: nexus-starship-guardians
description: Project-scoped Guardian operations with Cognitive Evolution, verified meta-learning, cross-Guardian knowledge transfer, confidence calibration, counterfactual replay, self-curricula, Adaptive Guardian Intelligence, Benchmark Replay, and Coverage Intelligence.
